# Anaplak Art & Glam Salon

> Anaplak Art & Glam Salon is a premium beauty, hair and bridal salon in Maduravoyal (MMDA Colony), Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. Founded in 2020 by Kalpana (Chief Stylist & Bridal Makeup Artist), it offers 13 service lines — bridal and event makeup, hair styling, keratin & smoothing treatments, hair colouring, hair extensions, facials, anti-aging skin treatments, manicure & pedicure, nail art & extensions, and threading & waxing — with a transparent price list on the /menu page. Open daily 10:00 AM–9:00 PM. Book via website, WhatsApp, phone or walk-in.

## BUSINESS INFO

- **Business name:** Anaplak Art & Glam Salon (also "Anaplak Salon")

## SERVICES & PRICING

Prices below are from the salon's public price list (/menu) and are a guide; the live menu is the source of truth.

### Bridal & Event Makeup
- **Bridal Makeup** (/services/bridal-makeup-chennai) — from ₹15,000: Bridal Classic ₹15,000 · HD ₹18,000 · Glossy ₹22,000 · Air Brush ₹30,000. Add-ons: Groom makeup ₹6,000 · Bridesmaids ₹7,000 · Kids (below 15) ₹3,000 · Saree draping ₹2,000 · Bridal hair style ₹3,000 · Trial ₹3,000 · Outdoor charges ₹3,000
- **Engagement Makeup** (/services/engagement-makeup-chennai) — from ₹15,000, includes complimentary hairstyling
- **Party Makeup** (/services/party-makeup-chennai) — ₹10,000, ~3 hours incl. styling-oriented session
- **Fashion & Editorial Makeup** (/services/fashion-editorial-makeup-chennai) — consultation-based pricing; free initial consultation

### Hair

- **Keratin & Smoothing (Hair Treatment)** (/services/hair-treatment-chennai) — keratin partial ₹3,500+, keratin full ₹7,000+, perming partial ₹3,500+, perming ₹7,000+, hair botox ₹8,000, botoplex ₹8,000, nano plastia ₹9,000 (customised); hair spa from ₹3,000; dandruff treatment from ₹4,000; results last ~3–6 months
- **Hair Colouring** (/services/hair-coloring-chennai) — root touch-up ₹1,800 (men)/₹2,000 (women); global colour ₹3,500/₹4,500; partial highlights ₹3,000+/₹4,500+; full highlights ₹5,000+/₹6,000+; fashion colour ₹5,000+/₹7,000+; creative colour ₹5,000+/₹7,000+; ammonia-free options available at a premium
- **Hair Extensions** (/services/hair-extension-chennai) — Clip & Go ₹20,000 (100g+), Tape ₹30,000 (100g+), Nano ₹30,000 (100g+), Men's patch ₹25,000 (100g+), maintenance ₹10,000

## FAQ (SUMMARY)

- **Booking:** Online (Welns.io), WhatsApp, phone, or walk-in.
- **Hours:** 10:00 AM–9:00 PM, seven days a week.
- **Parking:** Ground-floor parking available.
- **Languages:** English, Tamil, Hindi.
- **Bridal trial:** ₹3,000, recommended 2–3 weeks before the wedding.
- **Venue travel:** Outdoor charges from ₹3,000 depending on distance within Chennai.
- **Saree draping:** Available for bridal bookings at ₹2,000.
- **Treatment longevity:** Keratin/smoothing results typically last 3–6 months with sulfate-free home care.
